scientific.integrity: The parameterization and local expansion are derived algebraically from the source operator. The global multiplicity conclusion uses only continuity, the large-parameter asymptotic, and existence of a symmetric root. Finite numerical replay is corroborative only.
scientific.limitations: Restricted to adjacency pattern (4.1) with equal parity activity totals. The theorem proves a sufficient five-fixed-point interval and a complete nonsymmetric mass parameterization, but not the exact total fixed-point count for general order.

title: General-order parity symmetry breaking in a countable hard-core Cayley-tree operator
